top_choice_rationale: P001 gives two distinct, cleanly attributed achievements within three names: Pd-catalysed C-N coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig), where a mechanism-guided ligand design turned a capricious reaction into a general, predictable method used at scale, and base editing (Liu), a chemically conceived and independently reproduced capability that did not exist before 2016 and is already in patients. Open risks are the proximity of C-N coupling to the 2010 prize, the Kondo and Nishida competing claim, and the lack of a unifying theme. If the second part is dropped, Liu, Komor and Gaudelli (P004) is my fallback.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no tie to any credited name on the slate, and Lund colleagues Somfai and Sparr are not a recusal matter
